answer: Because a rotating auditor pool re-executes a random slice of every submission through unrelated peers, a farm pays twice for the same work and still has to match the outputs, so duplication costs more than honest production at every scale. Standing unlocks only after continuous uptime survives a long voyage of epochs and an agent at its nadir drops back to the entry queue, which sets the ferrous floor: one sybil, one machine, one rental bill, charged every month.
